title: A tblpPr table nested in a cell floats tblpY below its cell's content top, not the page top, and the empty paragraphs wrapping beside it do not extend the row
source: probe build.py -> Word for Mac direct PDF (2026-10-28), pymupdf drawings: Letter, Calibri 11; outer rules 85.68 / 246.96 / 408.24 (two rows of 161.28 = trHeight 150 + 2 x 5.4 cell margin + gridline), nested top rules 104.64 and 265.92 = 18.96 below each outer rule = 5.4 margin + 13.05 tblpY (+ half borders) in both rows although tblpY names page Y 13.05; nested rows 13.92; lead glyph top 72.05, tail 408.53

cases.note: the five empty paragraphs per cell wrap beside the float; nothing spills
both rows measure exactly their trHeight + cell margins: the float plus its anchor lines is shorter than the minimum
row 1: tblpY 261 twips below the cell content top; gen floats the nested table 12.42pt below the cell content top (margin-top 17.4px minus the cell padding convention), 0.63pt short of Word
row 2: same offset against its own cell, nowhere near page Y; gen 12.42pt, same as row 1
lead to tail: 13.44 line + 322.56 table + gridline
